name: command-capture-cwm-sol
description: Check the device by running commands and capturing the response. This is executed as a MOP workflow which the user can run to check the sanity of the device. The commands passed should be executed properly and there should be no failure during their execution. Failure: If the status returned from the NSO executor is failure, or if there is an issue in running it, the this workflow would fail.

definition.name: command-capture-cwm-sol

stateDataFilter.output: ${.selectedDevice = ((.deviceSelection.jsonPath | gsub("\\[(?<i>[0-9]+)\\]"; ".\(.i)") | split(".") | map(select(. != "")) | map(tonumber? // .)) as $path | getpath($path)) | ."app-data".device = .selectedDevice}

actionDataFilter.results: ${ if (.activityOutput.status == "success" and (.activityOutput.output | tostring | test("Invalid\\s*input\\s*detected"; "i"))) then (.activityOutput.status = "error" | .activityOutput.output = "Invalid command") elif .activityOutput.status == "success" then .activityOutput.output = (if .activityOutput.output."tailf-ned-cisco-ios-xr-stats:output".result != null then .activityOutput.output."tailf-ned-cisco-ios-xr-stats:output".result else .activityOutput.output."tailf-ned-cisco-ios-stats:output".result end) else . end | .activityOutput.command = .activity.execCommand | .activityOutput}

logs.message: Running the required commands in NSO

actionDataFilter.results: ${ if (.activityOutput.status == "success" and (.activityOutput.output | tostring | test("Invalid\\s*input\\s*detected"; "i"))) then (.activityOutput.status = "error" | .activityOutput.output = "Invalid command") elif .activityOutput.status == "success" then .activityOutput.output = .activityOutput.output."junos-rpc:output".output else . end | .activityOutput.command = .activity.execCommand | .activityOutput}

stateDataFilter.output: ${ .status= (if (.warnings | length > 0) then "warning" else "success" end) | .message=(if (.warnings | length == 0) then ("captured output for " + (.commandCapture | length | tostring) + " command(s)") else ("Command capture workflow encountered errors. Number of commands with error(s): " + (.outputCollection | map(select(.status == "error")) | length | tostring)) end) | .stash=(.commandCapture as $commandCapture | (.outputCollection | map(.output + "; command: " + .commandCapture.command)) | ([range(0; (.|length)) as $i | .[$i] + $commandCapture[$i].command]))}
